## What lives here
The YAML seed vocabularies: schemes, the industry → domain → subdomain tree, agent archetypes and industry knowledge entries.

## Conventions
Loaded in sorted name order, and later files win. The domain concepts live only in `industries.yaml`. Ids are never renamed, only re-parented.

## Entry points
Read by `catalog/seed_loader.load_seed`.
